name: Araria

queries.query: Araria Bihar official cadastral parcel map land records Bhu Naksha Bihar
queries.result: First-party discovery found the Government of Bihar BhuNaksha cadastral viewer, the Bihar Revenue and Land Reforms portal, and the official Araria district land-records page. The viewer's current JavaScript/configuration exposed public level-list, extent, WMS map, and ScalarDatahandler routes. No safe anonymous parcel ID-plus-full-geometry response was obtained.

queries.query: अररिया बिहार आधिकारिक भू नक्शा cadastral parcel map भूमि अभिलेख
queries.result: Hindi-language first-party discovery located the Hindi Araria district portal and BiharBhumi/Bhu-Naksha land-record services. The official BhuNaksha viewer lists Araria district, Araria subdivision/circle and mapped mauzas, but no safe anonymous native parcel identity plus full polygon response was qualified.

researchNote: A local/state public cadastral registry is evidenced: Government of Bihar BhuNaksha exposes Araria district hierarchy and public map routes; the official Araria district page directs users to Bihar land records. For a bounded test, POST getVVVVExtentGeoref with state=10 and gisLevels=07,01,01,0001,SS,00,00, returned EPSG:32645 extent and gisCode SS07010100011510000 for Pokharia mauza; a WMS GetMap request returned a 56 KB PNG. POST ListsAfterLevel for Araria circle returned mapped mauzas and survey types. No parcel vector endpoint or full geometry was retrieved; no sample GeoJSON is retained. This packet is not source integration or runtime admission.
